title: Shadow Queen's Ring of Brilliant Light!

html:
Shadow Queen's Ring of Brilliant Light!
Piece:  Ring
Defense Rating:  varies with item level

Shadow Queen's Ring of Brilliant Light! is a ring.

This ring is made of shadows but strangely gives off light.

This rainbow is specific to Queen of Shadows' lair chest. It is not in the shared mythic pool every boss rolls. The Wishing Well can also spit it out once you are high enough for that dungeon. The full list is on Boss Lair Rainbows.

Attributes:

The base item always carries:

  • + Intellect
  • + Shadow Damage
  • + Divine Damage Resistance
  • + Shadow Damage Resistance
  • + Divine Damage

Rolled copies can also pick up an extra ending. Those endings and their bonuses are listed on Mythic Suffixes.
